cells.text:
Upon finishing a reload within 5.3? ↑? seconds of a Kill:
Grants x2 Cure.
Allies within 15 metres receive x1 Cure.

official.excerpt: Now grants cure x2 to the player (still grants cure x1 to nearby allies).
does_not_establish: exact normal or enhanced activation window

reference_policy: Qualified weapon-credit kills refresh a holder/weapon window; same-session death ids are recorded before live-owner qualification.
Every matching qualified reload completion is recorded, including completions without a window; a later replay cannot spend a newly opened window within the receipt retention.
Consume the window before invoking shared Cure for self tier 2 and allied tier 1; preserve real giver and weapon into delayed healing and Benevolence.
Receipt retention is finite and independently cleans each identity; it does not cap causal depth or valid feedback loops.
Stow keeps the window; perk detachment and confirmed owner death clear it. Accepted Cure follows its shared lifecycle.
gaps: 普通窗口在原表与 Clarity 仍为 5.3?，强化增加量未知；测试 5.3 / 6.3 秒均为显式校准输入，不是已测原作数值。
刷新不叠次数、按完成时刻的半开窗口、收枪保留、卸下/死亡清除、先消费再尝试治疗、冷却/拒绝不退回窗口均为明确参考政策，原作边界待核对。
每次实际插入与显式 VERIFIED 零转移均可触发；普通补弹不触发。各具体武器、闪身、异域生产者的原作换弹资格及特殊信用仍需逐条装配校准。
15 米按执行时脚底球形距离、含端点且无视线，宿主友方实体也可接受；原作目标分类/几何，以及共享 Cure 两次 50ms 脉冲、0.1 生命缩放和跨死亡/重生边界未完整校准。
六十秒测试身份缓存只覆盖有限重放窗口，不是原作冷却，也不保证任意久远或跨独立会话的事实去重。
内容仍在验收资源；正式武器目录、完整武器数值、Merciless 等异域装配、子职业/HUD/表现与物理世界跨重启未完成。
